title: DoorDash has counted several hundred orders from outside AI agents
friendlyTitle: DoorDash has received only a few hundred orders from outside AI agents
summary: On DoorDash's third-quarter earnings call, CEO Tony Xu said the company is seeing maybe several hundred orders in total from third-party agents such as Muse, Instinct, and Fo. TechCrunch notes that DoorDash's 2025 report put average daily deliveries at 3 million. Xu said most people still order in the DoorDash app, and that the company wants a working relationship with agent makers rather than a fight.
